caveats: Each library is a biological pool, not a single animal. Treating the library as the independent unit is correct for this design.
Cell-level observations within a library are not independent biological replicates.
P1 and P8 biology differ; primary regenerative MI-vs-sham analysis should prefer the P1 stratum or model age explicitly.
No expression matrix is redistributed here; only metadata + locked split manifests.
experimental_unit: litter-level pool (8-12 ventricles from the same litter → one 10x library)

paper.authors: Wang Z, Cui M, Shah AM, Tan W, Liu N, Bassel-Duby R, Olson EN
paper.title: Cell-Type-Specific Gene Regulatory Networks Underlying Murine Neonatal Heart Regeneration at Single-Cell Resolution

source_of_unit_definition: STAR Methods + Figure 1 legend (n=8–12 animals pooled; n=1 library per condition×timepoint×age)

strata.note: P1 = regenerative; P8 = non-regenerative. Do not pool P1 and P8 without prespecified analysis.
